body.p: This is a Response to the Office Action mailed January 24, 2023, setting forth a restriction requirement.
The Examiner identified the following allegedly distinct groups of claims:
1.Claims 1-8, drawn to a system for monitoring patient movement, classified in A61B5/1 116.
11. Claims 9-17, drawn to a system for monitoring patient movement, classified in A61 H2201/1659.
Ill. Claims 18-20, drawn to a method for monitoring patient movement, classified in A61 N51037.

Applicant provisionally elects to prosecute the claims characterized by the Examiner as of Group I. Claims 1-8. The remaining claims characterized by the Examiner as of Group 111. Claims 9-17 and Ill. Claims 18-20 are withdrawn from consideration without prejudice to continue prosecution of the subject matter in a subsequent application.

Should the Examiner believe that a telephone or personal interview may facilitate resolution of any remaining matters, the Examiner is respectfully requested to contact Applicant's undersigned attorney at the telephone number indicated below.

It is believed that no fee is due for entry of the present amendment, however, if it is determined that a fee is required for entry of the present amendment, the Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge such fee to Deposit Account No. 132546.
Also, in the event any extensions of time for responding are required for the pending
application, please treat this paper as a petition to extend the time as required and charge
